en.headline: Around 1,700 budget amendments ruled inadmissible
en.subheadline: The Chamber's Budget Committee rejected roughly a quarter of proposals, including measures on paint markers and the exit tax.

body.text: The Chamber's Budget Committee declared more than 1,700 amendments to the budget bill inadmissible, representing about 25% of the 6,600 proposals submitted.
Among the rejected items were the right‑wing amendment on the exit tax and a proposal to use paint markers to identify violent demonstrators.
Alessandro Urzì, leader of the FdI group, said the decree‑law on marches will be discussed in the Justice Committee in the coming days.

why_it_matters.text: The large share of inadmissible amendments could limit the government's ability to modify tax and public‑order measures this session.

key_facts.text: 1,700 amendments (25% of 6,600) rejected by the Budget Committee

en.headline: Venice council set to meet on 26 November
en.subheadline: Agenda includes budget forecast and new tax‑revenue regulations

body.text: The Venice City Council will meet on Thursday 26 November at 9.30 a.m. in the Ca' Loredan council chamber, the official notice says.

The agenda lists the 2026‑2028 budget forecast (P.D. 2026.1087), a draft regulation on facilitated municipal revenue (P.D. 2026.1082) and a draft on preventive measures against local tax evasion (P.D. 2026.1083).
A variant (n. 131) to the Terraglio Nord intervention plan, aimed at acquiring green areas under regional law 11/2004, is also scheduled for discussion.

why_it_matters.text: Decisions on the budget and tax‑revenue rules could affect municipal finances and service provision in Venice for the 2026‑2028 period.

key_facts.text: Council meeting: 26 Nov 2026, 9.30, Ca' Loredan.

it.headline: Consiglio di Venezia si riunisce il 26 novembre
it.subheadline: All’ordine del giorno bilancio e nuove norme sulle entrate comunali

body.text: Il Consiglio comunale è convocato giovedì 26 novembre, alle ore 9.30 nella Sala consiliare di Ca' Loredan a Venezia, secondo l’avviso ufficiale.

All’ordine del giorno figurano il bilancio di previsione per gli esercizi 2026‑2028 (P.D. 2026.1087), il progetto di regolamento per la definizione agevolata delle entrate comunali (P.D. 2026.1082) e il progetto di regolamento per le misure preventive contro l’evasione dei tributi locali (P.D. 2026.1083).
È prevista anche la discussione della variante n. 131 al Piano degli Interventi per l’Area Terraglio Nord, finalizzata all’acquisizione di aree verdi secondo la L.R. n. 11/2004.

why_it_matters.text: Le decisioni sul bilancio e sulle norme fiscali potrebbero influire sulle finanze comunali e sui servizi a Venezia per il triennio 2026‑2028.

key_facts.text: Convocazione: 26 nov 2026, ore 9.30, Sala Ca' Loredan.

en.headline: Venezia approves Marittima parking plan
en.subheadline: Council approves agreement to create temporary parking and future multi‑storey facility for residents

body.text: The city council approved the agreement framework between the Comune di Venezia and the Autorità di Sistema Portuale del Mare Adriatico Settentrionale to define a shared strategy for parking at Marittima, with particular attention to residents of the city of water and the islands.
The first intervention is the demolition of Fabbricato 280, a port property long partially unusable, to create a temporary ground‑level parking lot in its place.
The agreement also outlines a path toward the future construction of a multi‑storey parking facility, with related ancillary and linking works, as part of a broader reordering of Marittima’s spaces.

key_facts.text: The first step is demolishing Fabbricato 280 to build a temporary parking lot.

body.text: Corriere della Sera reported that police seized assets valued at nearly €19 million from the former companion of businessman Felicino Riva.
Prosecutors allege she failed to declare the proceeds from the sale of a Milan palace to Armani, a claim echoed by multiple news agencies.
The property in via Borgonuovo 21 was sold for €73 million, and the seizure amount is reported as €18.8 million in other outlets.
